purpose: Wave-4 Slayer masters ladder + Smoking Kills point economy, permanent Slayer Rewards (prefer/block/extend, broad fletching, quick killing blows), Tirannwn death-altar RC, Asgarnia wicked hood, Misthalin ancient-curses / vis-wax RC guild history, and multi-region Prayer infrastructure (POH gilded altar + training stack). Complements slayer-toolbelt, mandrith, and wave4-critical-tools (which skipped wicked-hood + poh-gilded-altar into this pack).

policy.region_rule: region_hint is master/site geography. region_hints + optional_pressure_regions carry task-monster and quest pressure (combo:slayer-masters-vs-task-regions). required_regions only for hard dual gates. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global into region_hint.
policy.duplicate_guard: forinthry:mandrith-wilderness-slayer and kandarin:kuradal-dungeon-ferocious-ring-hub already exist — do not re-emit. multi-region:slayer-helmet-* / toolbelt attaches live in slayer-toolbelt pack. asgarnia:wicked-hood and multi-region:poh-gilded-altar were pending from wave4-critical-tools and are filed here.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman / Equilibrium no-trade framing: permanent unlocks, point sinks, altar infrastructure. No invented kill times or XP/hour.
policy.rate_rule: Slayer point tables and construction levels only. Prayer XP multipliers from wiki altar tables; training rates stay in training datasets.
policy.2026_current: Rune Goldberg Machine removed 16 March 2026 (Dailyscape Overhaul) — no new vis wax. Wicked hood daily essence/runes/free teleports also removed same patch; talisman storage + token teleports + unlimited RC Guild teleport remain. POH gilded altar still 350% with both burners.

activity_additions.name: Slayer prefer / block / extend (Assignment Rewards)
activity_additions.category: permanent multi-region Slayer task list control
requirements: Smoking Kills strongly recommended so point income is full rate
Slayer points from any eligible master (not Turael/Spria)
Prefer/block lists are shared across all masters
unlocks: Cancel task — 30 points: skip current assignment without streak penalty; next task progresses normally
Block task — 100 points: skip current + permanently remove that assignment from all masters' lists (until unblocked)
Prefer task — 100 points: auto-extends current assignment and approximately doubles future chance of that assignment
Extend task — 30 points: +20% kill count based on initial assignment size (no extra points vs boss reaper; cannot extend same task twice in a row if previous was extended)
region_pressure: Currency generation is master-region dependent (Sumona Desert, Duradel Karamja, Kuradal Kandarin, Morvran Tirannwn, Laniakea Anachronia, Mandrith Forinthry, etc.).
Blocked/preferred monsters often live in different regions than the master — this is the core combo with task geography.
activity_additions.notes: Account-state permanent. Mandrith exception is critical for Forinthry planning. Turael free skip resets streak — prefer 30-point Cancel when streak matters. Block slot count scales with account progression (quest points historically gate extra slots — verify current UI rather than hardcoding a count here).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Global unlock purchasable from any master shop. Score point-farm masters by region; score blocked-monster relief by task regions.
